message.content: The largest planet that astronomers have confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a mass roughly twice that of Jupiter (about 2 M_J) and a radius about 1.5 times Jupiter’s radius. Its size and mass make it one of the most massive “hot Jupiters” known, though there may still be larger planets out there that we haven’t yet detected.
